nodes.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

The [Cognition](https://cognition.com/) team reached our asking to replace "Windsurf" with "Devin" in the list of agents, since Cognition has acquired Windsurf and rebranded the app to Devin.

The install path for any skill files should also be updated to `.devin/skills/`

### Proposed solution

- Rename "Windsurf" to "Devin" in the list of agents
- Ensure this installs skill files in `.devin/skills/`

### Additional context

The rebrand / renaming is documented here: https://docs.devin.ai/desktop/devin-desktop-faq
nodes.title: Update Windsurf to Devin in `gh skill` agent list

nodes.body:
Ran this by the Cognition team (makers of Devin / Windsurf), and they said this looks good to them ✅ 

> Should this actually remove `windsurf`? Are there still users out there you might be using windsurf and not updating?

They confirmed that most users have updated to "Devin," so no need to keep around the legacy "Windsurf" option anymore.
It is technically a breaking change for anyone who did in a script `gh skill install --agent windsurf`. Might be worth a quick check on code search. Probably not a huge deal though.

@williammartin FWIW, `gh skill` is labelled as preview, so I'm fine with this change:


```
gh skill --help
...
Working with agent skills in the GitHub CLI is in preview and subject to change without notice.
...
```

## Pull request overview Updates the `gh skills install` agent registry to reflect Cognition’s rebrand from Windsurf to Devin, ensuring skills are installed into the correct Devin-specific directories. **Changes:** - Add a new `devin` agent host and install to `.devin/skills` at both project and user scope. - Remove the `windsurf` agent host entry and update registry tests to treat it as unsupported. - Update `gh skills install` help text to mention Devin instead of Windsurf.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | pkg/cmd/skills/install/install.go | Updates install command help text to include Devin and remove Windsurf. | | internal/skills/registry/registry.go | Replaces the Windsurf agent host entry with a Devin entry and `.devin/skills` install paths. | | internal/skills/registry/registry_test.go | Adds coverage for the new `devin` agent and asserts `windsurf` is now an unknown agent. |
